headline: Maui County Independent Nomination Board

meeting.summary: The Independent Nomination Board met in closed session on 2025 applications, then sent applicants forward for several boards and recessed until December 4th.
meeting.recap: The Independent Nomination Board was called to order at 3:39 p.m. on November 27th.[[0:00:36]] No one was in the room to testify, and there was no written testimony.[[0:01:48]] The board took up applications received through November 26 for 2025 nominations to boards, commissions and committees.[[0:02:28]] A motion was made to go into executive session (a closed-door discussion).[[0:03:11]] The board voted on the motion and went into executive session.[[0:04:49]] The board returned to open session at 6:04 p.m.[[0:05:04]] The chair said the board voted to send one Animal Control Board applicant forward for further approval.[[0:05:34]] One Civil Service Commission applicant was sent forward.[[0:05:46]] Three Commission on Children and Youth applicants were sent forward.[[0:05:53]] Three Council on Aging applicants were sent forward.[[0:06:13]] Two Commission on Persons with Disabilities applicants were sent forward.[[0:07:23]] The chair said the board would recess until December 4th at 4 p.m. in the same room.[[0:07:54]]
decided: The board voted to go into executive session; no count was stated.
meeting.next: The board will meet again in the same location with a different meeting ID listed on the agenda.
